Name: (CP) Sydney - A Custom NPC Festival Location Fix
Author: aerinanxiety
Description:
[center]﻿
[u][b]What is it?[/b][/u]
I have a little bit of a perfectionist streak in me, and when I see NPCs overlapping I [b]HAVE[/b] to fix them if the mod author is too busy, etc.

This mod specifically changes Y1 Egg Festival positioning of Sydney from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14158]Sydney - A Custom NPC[/url]﻿ to no longer overlap with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6307]Lucikiel - New Custom NPC (King's Raid)[/url]﻿. Also makes it so she doesn't intersect with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599]Professor Jasper Thomas[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6754]Aspen - New Custom Dateable NPC[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17309]Casper and the Box[/url].﻿

﻿[b][u]Installation
[/u][/b]Unzip the .rar file and drag its contents into your mods folder. Thats it!

[b][u]Have a request?
[/u][/b]If you find any schedule overlaps or festival overlaps in any NPC mods, please let me know!
If the creator of the mods has no intention of fixing the issue (most have bigger things to work on!) and I obtain permission, I'll do my best do push out a patch.[/center]
